bullets.title: CMCSA +22%: NBCU/Sky spinoff unlocks conglomerate discount; Charter merger seen as more likely
bullets.body: Comcast announced a tax-free spin-off of NBCUniversal and Sky into a separate public company (~1 year timeline); Mike Cavanagh to lead NBCU, Michael Angelakis to lead Comcast Cable RemainCo. KeyBanc SOTP puts RemainCo at high-$20s/low-$30s; Citi sees accelerated investment prioritization post-spin. Multiple analysts flag increased probability of a Comcast-Charter merger given CMCSA's strengthened balance sheet, though mgmt downplayed further M&A. Options volume surged 294% with P/C of 0.31.

bullets.title: CHTR +22%: SpaceX/Starlink mobile partnership talks add to spin-off catalyst
bullets.body: Charter held executive-level talks with SpaceX on a consumer mobile phone offering that would route Starlink traffic through Spectrum's WiFi/small-cell network. Citi cut CHTR PT to $190 from $230 on tougher 2Q comps but maintains Buy. The CMCSA spin is seen as a structural positive for Charter's competitive positioning versus mobile network operators.

bullets.title: AAPL raises Mac/iPad prices 15-25% on memory cost spike; iPhone hikes expected in September
bullets.body: Apple announced 15-25% price increases on Macs, iPads, and accessories citing unprecedented component cost inflation; CEO Cook said he has never seen increases this significant. iPhones excluded for now but hikes expected with iPhone 18 in September. Morgan Stanley (OW, $360 PT) sees margin protection pivot; Wedbush (OW, $400 PT) sees limited demand elasticity risk; UBS (Neutral, $296 PT) notes without hikes margins would fall to ~35.9% in September quarter. AAPL also reportedly lobbying for permission to source DRAM from China's CXMT.

bullets.title: MU: $100B+ LT contracts and AI memory super-cycle thesis reinforced; semis sell-off deemed noise
bullets.body: Micron signed $100B+ long-term memory contracts (2026-2030) at minimum pricing, signaling a strategic shift from commodity to supply security. Klein (OPCO) characterizes last week's -5% SOX drop and TXN -8.5% as end-of-quarter rebalancing, not fundamental deterioration; MU rallied 15% post-earnings. DRAM/NAND supply is described as significantly below true end demand, with HBM pricing negotiations in fall 2027 expected to show triple-digit Y/Y ASP increases.

bullets.title: PLTR +4%: Strategic initiative with NVIDIA; launches Nemotron sovereign deployment engine
bullets.body: Palantir launched an engine for deploying NVIDIA Nemotron open models in sovereign environments, driving +4.0% pre-market. This follows broader PLTR momentum as an AI-infrastructure beneficiary.

bullets.title: APP initiated Strong Buy/$640 PT at Raymond James; ad ecosystem tone constructive post-Cannes
bullets.body: Raymond James initiated AppLovin at Strong Buy with a $640 PT. Post-Cannes, Citi describes the ad ecosystem tone as constructive: Search, Social, and CTV demand healthy, with LLM Search budgets incremental. GOOGL, AMZN, META, and RDDT flagged as Citi top picks into 2Q.

bullets.title: RBLX: Citi maintains Buy; 2Q26 CCUs tracking +6% YoY, bookings ~$1.57B vs $1.59B consensus
bullets.body: Week 26 peak CCUs of 16.0M were down 3% YoY, but QTD CCUs are +6% vs 2Q25. Citi projects 2Q26 bookings of $1.57B, slightly below the Visible Alpha consensus of $1.59B and at the low end of guidance ($1.55B-$1.61B). Separately, Arete Research upgraded RBLX to Buy with a $95 PT, sending shares +6.1% pre-market.

bullets.title: VZ: Q2 $700-800M loss on BT JV held-for-sale reclassification; $625M equalization payment
bullets.body: Verizon announced a 50:50 JV with BT Group combining international operations across 180+ countries with $4B combined annual revenue. Q2 charges total up to $1.55B: $700-800M held-for-sale loss, $350-450M severance, and $200-300M asset rationalization. VZ trades -1.1% pre-market; T also -0.8% as telecom sector faces structural pressure.

bullets.title: WULF: Citi initiates Buy/High Risk at $36 PT on 250-500 MW annual HPC data center scaling
bullets.body: Citi initiated TeraWulf at Buy/High Risk with a $36 PT, forecasting 14.5 GW HPC absorption in 2026 and 20 GW avg 2027-2030. Shares +3.2% pre-market on the initiation.

bullets.title: WBD upgraded to Buy/$31 PT at Seaport; TV ad upfront described as weak with Fox/Disney sports benefiting
bullets.body: Warner Bros. Discovery upgraded to Buy from Neutral at Seaport Research Partners with a $31 PT. Separately, Wolfe notes the TV advertising upfront was weak in June with WBD and Paramount most cautious, while Fox Broadcast and Disney sports benefited from strong demand.

bullets.title: TOST: Citi flags attractive entry at 14.5x 2027E EBITDA vs 3-year avg of 37.2x
bullets.body: Toast is guiding mid-20s ARR growth in 2026 vs low-20s location growth; 2Q recurring gross profit growth guidance of 22-23% YoY. Citi views current valuation as a buying opportunity given the discount to historical multiples.

bullets.title: HOOD +2.4%: June MTD equity volumes ~$343B, options ~274M contracts, crypto ~$14B
bullets.body: Robinhood closed a $2.2B convertible senior notes offering (0% coupon, due 2029) and repurchased 2.743M shares with $290M of proceeds. Strong June trading volumes across equities, options, and crypto are driving the pre-market move. KeyBanc has HOOD PT $100 under review.

bullets.title: GLW: GlassBridge fiber-to-PIC tech offers long-term FAU disruption but limited 1-2yr impact on AI transceivers
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley notes Corning's GlassBridge platform (officially launched June 24) provides a wafer-based alternative to traditional Fiber Array Units, posing disruption risk to FAU makers but very limited near-term impact on AI transceiver companies. The technology was already part of Corning's $10B Photonics target outlined at its Analyst Day.

bullets.title: Samsung/SK Hynix $3.55tn capex expansion bullish for semiscap; DRAM/NAND upcycle seen through 2Q28
bullets.body: Samsung announced Won2,450tn and SK Hynix Won1,100tn in semiconductor investments over 2026-2040, including a new Jeonnam-Gwangju cluster and accelerated Yongin ramp. UBS maintains Overweight on WFE stocks (Buy: AMAT, ASML, LRCX, Tokyo Electron) and expects the DRAM/NAND upcycle to extend through at least 2Q28/4Q27.

bullets.title: QCOM: Data center revenue target raised to $15B by F29E (50x growth); TP raised to $210, Neutral maintained
bullets.body: Klein (OPCO) raises QCOM TP to $210 while maintaining Neutral; QCOM is targeting $15B in data center revenue by F29E and $10B in auto revenues, with non-handset revenues targeting $40B (40% CAGR F25-29E). Separately, QCOM is reportedly nearing a ~$4B acquisition of AI chip startup Modular Inc.

bullets.title: ABNB screens as best OTA setup for 2Q/2026; EXPE more cautious on steeper 2H comps
bullets.body: Hedgeye flags ABNB as the best-positioned OTA for Q2 and full-year 2026, citing less AI disruption risk than peers. EXPE is described as lagging in Q2 bookings with more cautious outlook on steeper second-half comparisons. ABNB hit a 52-week high, +2.7% on the day and +11.8% YTD.

bullets.title: RH: London gallery opens with strong attendance; Estates expansion enlarges TAM
bullets.body: RH's Mayfair London gallery launched with strong attendance and media coverage; RH England did ~$45M+ in Year 2 revenue, with Paris/Milan/London galleries transitioning from expense to revenue-generating assets. The Estates launch opens new consumer segments via trade/designer partnerships.

bullets.title: SHOP +1.6% today, +7.8% last week; still -25% YTD despite recent momentum
bullets.body: Shopify traded up 1.6% Monday to C$168.41 and gained 7.78% over the prior week, but remains down 25% YTD. No new fundamental catalysts cited in today's flow.

bullets.title: CRM and ADBE double-downgraded by Phillip Securities; CRWD cut to neutral by Arete
bullets.body: Phillip Securities downgraded both Salesforce (CRM) to Neutral with a sharply cut PT of $166 (from $253) and Adobe (ADBE) to Neutral with PT cut to $203 (from $487). Arete Research downgraded CrowdStrike (CRWD) to Neutral with a $730 PT.

bullets.title: 22V: Costless 1x2 call-spread overlay on MSFT, AMZN, ORCL, META, NFLX for 2H26 hyperscaler recovery
bullets.body: 22V recommends 6-month costless call-spread overlays on hyperscalers given elevated vol and rich call skew at multi-year highs; views Mag-7 underperformance since mid-May as mid-cycle rotation rather than end of AI bull market. Infrastructure beneficiaries (memory, power) favored over hyperscalers near term; NVDA and MU alone expected to drive ~40% of S&P 500 Q2 EPS growth.
